test_case.purpose: Prove the system remains awake, responsive, low-activity and error-free for 24 continuous hours at measured margin without unintended sleep or hidden workload.
test_case.test_command: Capture original power settings, services, uptime and logs; apply only approved reversible sleep/hibernate changes; establish calibrated 40C/+5% rails; leave the DUT undisturbed for 24 hours while recording heartbeat, uptime, sleep/wake state, utilization/power, environment and errors; restore power settings and nominal environment and verify health.
test_case.expected_result: The DUT remains continuously awake and reachable within approved idle bounds for 24 hours, environment stays in tolerance, no disallowed BMC/system error, hang or BSOD occurs, and all settings/environment restore successfully.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires continuous 24-hour heartbeat/uptime plus idle and environment evidence. Sleep, hidden load, telemetry gap, shortened soak, cleared logs or only start/end screenshots cannot pass.
safety_gate: Preserve original settings/logs and never disable safety controls
Qualified operator controls environment and maintains OOB
Abort on heartbeat, thermal/rail or error-policy violation
test_case.recovery: On loss of heartbeat, unintended sleep, environment or error fault, preserve evidence, use OOB to reach a safe state, restore approved power settings and nominal environment, verify health, and do not restart the 24-hour soak automatically.
